basic_profile.bio: I'm a craft beer enthusiast hailing from San Diego, California. I work as a software engineer by day and a homebrewer by night. My weekends are often spent exploring local breweries or catching up on the latest in the craft beer community. I have a keen interest in rare and limited-edition beers, particularly those with unique flavor profiles. I'm usually online in the evenings, around 7-11 PM PST, after a long day of coding. I'm in a long-term relationship with my partner who shares my passion for beer tasting and travel.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep knowledge of craft beer, developed over years of personal interest and experience. I've attended various beer festivals and have been a member of several beer clubs. My technical expertise comes from my background in computer science, having earned a degree in the field and worked in tech for over 5 years.
